notes: Fixed a false-positive ghost-position alert that could fire on a genuinely legitimate sell (BTGO was sold for real profit but got flagged as a ghost) - a fresh check now confirms the position wasn't already legitimately closed before firing the alert. Also added the actual exit reason (stop loss, trailing stop, profit target, etc.) to the Alpaca order/fill notifications that were missing it - trade_history already tracked this correctly, it just wasn't shown in these notifications.
